general: Holiday allowance is an accrued entitlement that must be correct on the first day in the new system — an incorrect accrual shows up immediately at the first salary run.
This tab contains the accrued holiday allowance basis per employee on the AFAS go-live date. Below are the columns with sample data and frequently asked questions.

Medewerker.description: Employee number in AFAS. Must match the Medewerker column in the employees file.

Bedrag.description: Holiday allowance still to be paid out on the reference date (gross). Use a period as the decimal separator.

Grondslag.description: Cumulative gross salary over the accrued months, as the basis for the holiday allowance calculation. Tip: check whether Bedrag ÷ Grondslag ≈ 0.08 (8%).

faq.question: How do I check the holiday allowance basis?
faq.answer: The basis is the cumulative gross salary over the accrual period (normally 1 June through 31 May). Check: Bedrag ÷ Grondslag × 100 ≈ 8%. Watch out for CAOs (collective labour agreements) with a deviating holiday allowance percentage.
